per_object_cap.stated: not applicable: an inference endpoint stores nothing for the caller

egress.terms: the response is the payload; no separate egress term is published

tooling: any OpenAI SDK with base URL https://open.bigmodel.cn/api/paas/v4/; curl against POST https://open.bigmodel.cn/api/paas/v4/chat/completions with Authorization: Bearer YOUR_API_KEY.
chaining: a free 200K-context text model and a free vision model are a zero-cost first pass in a two-stage pipeline; only the survivors go to a metered model

free_tier.stated: Two models are free on input, output and cache, with no token cap or expiry stated: the text model GLM-4.7-Flash (200K context) and the vision model GLM-4.6V-Flash. Concurrency per model is the only published constraint and the per-model figure sits behind a login
free_tier.notes: perpetual free models; the login page advertises a new-user experience pack of 20 million tokens (2000万); its model scope, expiry and any real-name condition are unverified: behind a sign-up

limits.value: concurrency, the number of requests in flight at one moment, is capped per model and per user-rights tier (levels V0 to V3, raised by points that only cash-balance spending earns); the per-model figure for the free text model is on a login-gated page and is unverified

binding_note: concurrency per model and per user-rights tier; platform-level throttling can apply at peak load

identity_cost.detail: registration accepts a non-mainland phone number: choose the country code and verify by SMS code. The FAQ states API calls do not require real-name authentication (it is recommended for account security, and is the route to an enterprise account); whether the API-key page asks for it is unverified: behind a sign-up

reliability_note: not assessed: no request was sent to the endpoint
confidence_note: the endpoint, routes and bearer scheme come from first-party docs pages and first-party OpenAPI specs; a keyless request returned HTTP 401 as expected. The key, account quota and per-model concurrency remain unverified behind a sign-up.

interface_detail: OpenAI Chat Completions compatible. The platform is served by the first-party Zhipu inference API, with chat at POST https://open.bigmodel.cn/api/paas/v4/chat/completions and models at GET https://open.bigmodel.cn/api/paas/v4/models; auth is a bearer key in Authorization: Bearer YOUR_API_KEY, created on the API Keys page after sign-in, with a JWT Token scheme also documented. GLM Coding Plan uses separate base URLs and separate keys.
